creative_direction: Draw two similar-sized eyes whose upper arches sit at slightly different heights. Keep the difference modest, as if one lid has relaxed a little. Both large dark pupils look right. Reserve broad blunt paper patches inside them, avoiding identical highlights. Use only short lower pen marks and small flat iris accents. Give one short brow a shallow bend and leave the other nearly level. Let line pressure change naturally at a couple of turns. The centered pair suggests dry humor. No mouth.
